none_means: No qualifying prior reference verified; not a proof of novelty.

problem_class.label: other
problem_class.details: Unconstrained monotone root finding: differentiable F:E→E satisfies ⟨F(x)−F(y),x−y⟩≥0 and has a zero xstar with ‖x0−xstar‖≤R. No scalar objective is specified.

oracle.label: other
oracle.details: Each call at x returns exact F(x) and a linear map J with ‖J−DF(x)‖≤δ in operator norm. Errors may depend arbitrarily on history and oracle seeds; no independence or unbiasedness is required.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: E is a finite-dimensional real inner-product space; the budget has no dimension dependence.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: Globally Lipschitz Jacobian: ‖DF(x)−DF(y)‖≤M‖x−y‖. Public information includes E, x0, M>0, δ≥0, R>0 and ε>0; F and its zero are hidden. Jacobian errors have a uniform absolute bound for every query, history and seed.

accuracy.label: almost_sure
accuracy.details: The residual bound holds almost surely under the joint algorithm-seed and oracle-seed law.

accuracy.label: other
accuracy.details: Return a single point x with operator residual ‖F(x)‖≤ε, using a fixed budget O(1+(MR²/ε)^(2/5)+δR/ε) of joint operator/Jacobian calls.
accuracy.evidence: LongTails/Setups/InexactJacobianMonotone.lean: spec.successful; supplied extracted result budget; LongTails/Template.lean: executeWithTrace

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: Monotone root finding with Lipschitz Jacobian is established, but exact operator values paired with arbitrary uniformly bounded Jacobian errors and an almost-sure residual guarantee define a specialized oracle formulation.
